keyPhrases.text: Ask, Mr. Billington, and ye shall receive
who'll be tough to beat come Tony Awards time
There's a little too much talk
what would any work about a tortured artist be without a few rough patches

reasoning: Strong positive review with an A- grade. Praises Molina's performance as Tony-worthy and 'luminescent,' approves of Logan's focused approach, but notes minor flaws in dialogue and character development. The critic frames even the criticisms as acceptable within the genre.
